description: Geeky Orchestration plugin hooks — guard edits to frozen planning artifacts. Default mode is warn (advisory, surfaced via portable stdout+stderr). The guard is now STAGE-AWARE: it stays silent for a pre-freeze package (no task has left the Backlog lane in kanban.md) and only fires once the package is frozen, so --mode block is safe to enable if you want a hard stop — change the command to append --mode block (emits Claude/Codex deny JSON). The shipped default stays warn on purpose. The guard also fails CLOSED on a malformed payload (empty/unparseable stdin, no tool_name, no file_path on Edit/Write/NotebookEdit): it cannot tell such a call is safe, so block mode denies it and warn mode warns loudly. Set GEEKY_PREFREEZE_LANES (comma-separated, default "Backlog") to widen the pre-freeze lane set, e.g. "Backlog,Ready" when packages rest in Ready between geeky-plan and geeky-implement. Runs the Python hook via hooks/py-run.sh, which probes python3 → python → py -3 so the same line works on Windows, macOS, and Linux without assuming a specific interpreter name. To prefer PowerShell on Windows: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard-planning-contract.ps1" -Mode warn
